rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a room, home, or other place with plenty of space.

example.english: This home is spacious and bright, so it is very comfortable to live in.
example.traditional: 呢間屋又闊落又光猛，住得好舒服。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 uk1 jau6 fut3 lok6 jau6 gwong1 maang5 zyu6 dak1 hou2 syu1 fuk6

rows.note: In casual speech, use this when describing a particular room or place as big and therefore roomy rather than choosing a dedicated word for spaciousness.

example.english: Look at this room—it is so spacious that there is still room for several tables.
example.traditional: 你睇下呢間房，好大，擺幾張枱都仲有位。
example.jyutping: nei5 tai2 haa5 ne1 gaan1 fong4 hou2 daai6 baai2 gei2 zoeng1 ci4 dou1 zung6 jau5 wai6

rows.note: Use this more formal or written alternative, especially in descriptions of rooms, buildings, and interiors.

example.english: The living room is spacious and bright, with plenty of natural light.
example.traditional: 客廳寬敞明亮，採光亦十分充足。
example.jyutping: haak3 teng1 fun1 cong2 ming4 loeng6 coi2 gwong1 jik6 sap6 fan1 cung1 zuk1
